title: Hexadecimal Byte Aligner
statement: Given an array of 32-bit unsigned integers, pack each integer into big-endian byte order and output each byte as an uppercase 2-digit hexadecimal number separated by spaces. If the number of bytes is not a multiple of 4, pad with zeros.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The next line contains N unsigned 32-bit integers.
output_format: Print each byte in big-endian order as uppercase 2-digit hex (e.g. 0A 1B FF) separated by spaces.

hidden_tests.expected_output: 00 00 00 FF 00 00 FF FF 00 FF FF FF
